events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state and dashboard parsing
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline -3 origin/main && git branch -r --contains 389886e3 2>&1 | head -3; sed -n 1,130p cloud/src/dashboard.ts | grep -n -i -E "stats|calendar|metricool|fetch|tantra" | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read tantraDashRead parser
events.input: $ grep -n "tantraDashRead" cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts | head -2; n=$(grep -n "export async function tantraDashRead" cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "$((n-30)),$((n+40))p" cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read email parser and key var names
events.input: $ n=$(grep -n "export async function tantraEmailNumbers" cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "$n,$((n+12))p" cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts; grep -c "" ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env; sed -E 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env

events.text: Now the approved read-only GETs, printing only structure (keys and types), never the key.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read-only GETs on Tantra API, print shapes only
events.input: $ cd /tmp && K=$(sed -n 's/^TANTRA_API_KEY=//p' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env | tr -d '"\r'); B=https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read stats and campaign shapes
events.input: $ K=$(sed -n 's/^TANTRA_API_KEY=//p' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env | tr -d '"\r'); B=https://api.usetantra.com/api/v1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find deploy scripts and running local stack
events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor 389886e3 origin/main && echo "389886e3 on origin"; ls cloud/scripts | grep -i -E "deploy|build" | head; grep -n -E '"(deploy|build)[^"]*"' cloud/package.json app/package.json | head; lsof -ti:8790,8794 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read centre build script
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/build.sh | head -40; grep -n -E "assets|main|name" cloud/wrangler.toml | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check where export builds
events.input: $ grep -n -E "^W=|mktemp|TMPDIR|node_modules" app/scripts/export-static.sh | head; ls cloud/wrangler.* ; sed -n 40,80p cloud/scripts/build.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read export script head
events.input: $ sed -n 1,16p app/scripts/export-static.sh

events.text: Parsers match the real Tantra shapes. Now redeploying the committed test-run fix from a clean worktree under the home folder.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree, tsc and probe
events.input: $ WT=$HOME/t265-deploy && rm -rf "$WT" && git worktree add -q --detach "$WT" origin/main && cd "$WT" && git log --oneline -1 && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/node_modules cloud/node_modules && (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -3; echo tsc=$?; node scripts/probe-t265.mjs 2>&1 | tail -2)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count probe passes and build centre
events.input: $ cd $HOME/t265-deploy/cloud && node scripts/probe-t265.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c ^PASS; node scripts/probe-t265.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v ^PASS | head -3; bash scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev 2>&1 | tail -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect Turbopack error
events.input: $ cd $HOME/t265-deploy/cloud && bash scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|navigat|symlink|outside" | head -8

events.text: The chained symlink leaves the worktree. Use an APFS clone copy of node_modules instead of a symlink.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clone node_modules and rebuild centre
events.input: $ cd $HOME/t265-deploy && rm app/node_modules && cp -cR /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && cd cloud && bash scripts/build.sh https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev 2>&1 | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Deploy revops-centre Worker
events.input: $ cd $HOME/t265-deploy/cloud && git status --short | head -5; npx wrangler deploy 2>&1 | grep -E -i "version id|deployed|error|https://" | head -5

events.text: Deployed d74278df. Verifying live and checking for leftover local test rows.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check live centre and local stack

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find local test attendee rows
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}\n" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/onboarding/?v=265e"; grep -n -E '"database_name"' wrangler.jsonc; DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/'); npx wrangler d1 execute $DB --local --command "SELECT id,name,email,test,status FROM attendees WHERE email LIKE '%growthcluborg%' OR name LIKE '%Adi test%'" 2>&1 | grep -E '"id"|"name"|"status"|"test"|error' | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: List local D1 tables
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --local --json --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'" 2>&1 | grep -o '"name": *"[^"]*"' | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 1500

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show local test attendees and driver cleanup
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --local --json --command "SELECT * FROM attendees WHERE lower(email) LIKE '%growthcluborg%' OR name LIKE '%Adi test%'" 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);r=d[0]["results"];print(len(r));[print({k:v for k,v in x.items() if k in("id","name","email","test","revoked","created_at","cohort")}) for x in r]'; grep -n -i -E "delete|cleanup|rm " scripts/run-t265-testrun.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find driver persist path and cleanup
events.input: $ sed -n 1,30p scripts/run-t265-testrun.mjs | grep -n -E "persist|8790|8794|state|tmp|email|delete" ; grep -n -E "persist-to|DELETE|unlink|rmSync" scripts/run-t265-testrun.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find leftover simulator state dirs
events.input: $ ls -d /tmp/t265-testrun-* 2>/dev/null; grep -n -E "CENTRE_PORT *=|FUNNEL_PORT *=|rmSync|kill" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/scripts/run-t265-testrun.mjs | head

events.text: Deploy is done; now cleaning up the simulator's local test rows (they live only in the driver's /tmp state dirs; ports 8790/8794 belong to another lane and stay untouched).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm driver stopped and inspect state dirs
events.input: $ for p in 8920 8922 8924; do curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; for d in /tmp/t265-testrun-*; do echo "$d: $(ls $d | tr '\n' ' ')"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Delete simulator test state and remove deploy worktree
events.input: $ rm -rf /tmp/t265-testrun-CrqsSN /tmp/t265-testrun-SiECSE /tmp/t265-testrun-afUVmz /tmp/t265-testrun-cCg2F7 && ls -d /tmp/t265-testrun-* 2>&1 | head -1; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git worktree remove --force $HOME/t265-deploy && git worktree prune && echo wt-removed; grep -c "fixed d74b090 (T-265)" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md

events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-265 status=review needs_from_owner="" note="Read-only GETs on api.usetantra.com (campaigns, campaigns/:id/stats, dashboard/calendar-metrics) all returned 200 and collectDash's parser matches the real fields (stats.totalContacts/totalEvents, rsvpStats accepted/tentative/declined, calendar_invite_sent, calendar_meetings_booked), so no fix was needed.
